promotion.statement: This is a non-promotional experiment. Its own pass rule is REPORT-ONLY. It can never size up, join the book, or feed walk-forward. Promotion requires the full desk path: a filing, a Garwe LOCK, the desk gates (profit factor at least 1.15 net at 0.31% per leg, a confidence interval excluding zero, beats random, week clusters, at least 50% of folds, no losing regime, max drawdown under 25%, at least 30 weeks and at least 100 leg-trades per year), and a holdout. BL8 and the filtered W11S variant are covered by this clause. 2026 warmup counts as veto-only and is not a promotion sample.

primary.definition: incumbent L01/F111 plus original BL8, plus the original unfiltered 3R short at full size 1%/10%
primary.rationale: It is the cipher study's original unfiltered hypothesis, the exact claim under test; half-size and filtered variants are derivative choices.

interim_review.statement: Interim reviews are veto-only. An interim review can stop or void the run. It cannot promote, re-pick PRIMARY, or change any config. No config is swapped after LOCK.

start_rule: first complete hourly signal strictly after verified activation; no retrospective fills

execution.entry: first fresh timestamped actionable quote in scheduled next-minute window, never a retrospective open
execution.paper_cost_model: visible spread/depth plus adverse assumption, not measured exchange fills
execution.funding: observed signed settlement rate, minute-open proxy explicitly labelled; missing never zero
execution.missing_quotes: no fabricated fills; record gap, keep exits active, quarantine affected outcome

reporting.first_technical_check: after first full scan; zero fills may be valid
reporting.decision_review: 90 calendar days primary review; report actual sample size and paired uncertainty. Inconclusive evidence continues unchanged. 30/60-day reviews check operation and risk, with no outcome-driven parameter changes.
reporting.calendar_years: prospective years only; historical 2022-25 results remain separately labelled
reporting.confidence: paired weekly simulated-portfolio increments, predeclared contrasts IC-I, IM-I, IF-I; short samples descriptive; do not rank or crown a config or cost
reporting.success: positive incremental net return at primary costs with drawdown trade-off reported; investigate whether gaps or concentration overturn conclusion; severe secondary, not sole veto
reporting.presentation: Four strategy comparisons, one per config, in fixed order I, IC, IM, IF. desk031, baseline, and moderate are prominent, with desk031 first. Severe is secondary display only. The one BINDING statistic is the paired weekly IC-minus-I P&L difference at desk031. Desk gates apply to that stream. Profit factor is taken from the challenger's own leg-trades. IC and I book metrics are REPORT-ONLY. IC book max drawdown must stay under 25% as a veto. Every cell is REPORT-ONLY. The 16 portfolios are 16 looks at one idea, not 16 tests. Interim reviews are veto-only and cannot swap a config after LOCK. Grade cap B.

explicit incumbent signal/execution mapping to saved A00 and L01/F111 plus BL8

evidence_window.bear_spell_classifier: Desk rule from Garwe LSR v2 countersign 8c3bd709 A3: BTC 4h EMA50 vs EMA200, +/-1% band; loss as in c90d9e3c. BEAR = EMA50 < EMA200*0.99; BULL = EMA50 > EMA200*1.01; CHOP otherwise. Each week-cluster is labelled by the regime at its Monday 00:00 UTC open. Soko's live label is not used. No-losing-regime gate: each of BULL, BEAR and CHOP needs >=4 non-empty clusters, otherwise the result is INCOMPLETE, not PASS.
evidence_window.bear_spell_note: The regime rule is regime_rule, copied verbatim from Garwe. The classifier has not been run on real bars or on 2026.

fixed_2026_window.statement: The fixed 2026 window applies only if the operator approves the carve-out. It is off by default. The forward window is the evidence window that is in force.

clone_screen.statement: Weekly P&L rho is SEEN, already-seen in-sample, on 2022-01-01 00:00 UTC through 2025-12-31 23:00 UTC. It is a disqualifier only: rho above 0.50 is FAIL. It is not supporting evidence, it is not part of the case for the edge, and it is not used for promotion. Entry-timestamp Jaccard above 0.50 is also FAIL. Any bar timestamp after 2025-12-31 23:00 UTC raises, which includes every 2026 bar. The screen reads CIPHER_FORWARD_TAPE_DIR and does not fetch.

planning_sim.label: SEEN
planning_sim.statement: SEEN planning inputs only, never evidence and never for promotion. An effect under 2x breakeven means REJECT at LOCK. The run waits on CIPHER_FORWARD_TAPE_DIR. Nothing is tuned.

regime_rule: Desk rule from Garwe LSR v2 countersign 8c3bd709 A3: BTC 4h EMA50 vs EMA200, +/-1% band; loss as in c90d9e3c. BEAR = EMA50 < EMA200*0.99; BULL = EMA50 > EMA200*1.01; CHOP otherwise. Each week-cluster is labelled by the regime at its Monday 00:00 UTC open. Soko's live label is not used. No-losing-regime gate: each of BULL, BEAR and CHOP needs >=4 non-empty clusters, otherwise the result is INCOMPLETE, not PASS.
